aboutText: Abba Electrical has been serving Richmond and Melbourne's inner east for over 13 years. Our licensed electricians specialise in both residential and commercial electrical services, alongside comprehensive building maintenance solutions. We take pride in elevating the art of property care, where every detail is meticulously managed. From complex switchboard upgrades to routine maintenance, Richmond trusts Abba Electrical for dependable, quality workmanship every time.
